subject: Re: Update to service setup
text: Thanks for getting back to us. I want to make sure we are aligned before the next setup task. In your last message, you asked for the “reporting module to be enabled right away.” I understood that as a request to activate the reporting dashboard now, even though your current plan only includes it after onboarding is complete. You seem to believe the request meant only scheduling a future review, and that is where our reading of the note differs. Practically, I have paused the module activation to avoid unexpected charges on the first invoice. The setup checklist still marks onboarding as in progress, and the reporting tools would normally open after the final training step. If we enable them now, access would be granted, but usage support would also begin earlier, which could complicate the timeline. To clarify what I need from you: please confirm whether you want immediate access now, accepting that support coverage starts this week, or whether you prefer the scheduled activation after the onboarding review. Either option is workable. If you choose immediate access, reply with the phrase “enable now” and I will proceed today. If you prefer the original timing, reply with “keep schedule,” and no charges will change for now. I can also add a short note to the account so our team does not repeat the same question. Let me know which option matches your intent, and I will update the record promptly. This keeps everything transparent for billing and project expectations.
